jokes.hikaru_nakamura: Hikaru’s best premove is “I literally don’t care”—he has it queued up before Magnus even sits down.
jokes.rfk_jr: JFK wanted to put a man on the moon. RFK Jr. wants to put a kid back in an iron lung.
jokes.sherlock_holmes: Sherlock, you’re a cocaine addict who lives with a doctor. Those aren’t investigations—Watson’s just taking you on supervised walks.
jokes.demis_hassabis: Demis Hassabis won a Nobel Prize in Chemistry but still needs Gemini to explain that the waitress is just being polite.
jokes.steph_curry: Steph Curry called his documentary *Underrated* because *Millionaire’s Son Bravely Overcomes Being Only Six-Foot-Two* wouldn’t fit on the poster.
jokes.sam_altman: Sam Altman named a closed-source company “OpenAI”—so when ChatGPT confidently bullshits you, that’s not a bug; it’s a family tradition.
jokes.lisa_manoban: Lisa calls herself a “Rockstar,” but when you Shazam her music, it just takes you to the Louis Vuitton checkout.
jokes.alex_honnold: Alex Honnold climbed El Capitan without a rope, yet still needed a rock to carry his movie.
jokes.jon_stewart: Jon Stewart’s entire act is playing a Fox News clip and waiting for the audience to spot what’s wrong—he’s Dora the Explorer for people with master’s degrees.
jokes.dario_amodei: Dario Amodei warns that AI could destroy humanity, then sells it for $20 a month—he’s a doomsday cult leader who remembered to turn on recurring billing.
jokes.pam_anderson: Pamela Anderson’s red swimsuit deserves an Oscar—it carried her entire career on two straps and no dialogue.
jokes.whitney_cummings: Whitney Cummings made a sex robot of herself. Most comedians ignore hecklers; she heard “go fuck yourself” and started getting quotes from manufacturers.
jokes.donald_trump: Donald Trump is a spam email with a spray tan: ALL CAPS, unbelievable promises, and somehow this billionaire still needs fifty bucks from your grandma.
jokes.james_franco: James Franco got an Oscar nomination for acting opposite a rock in *127 Hours*—Anne Hathaway did the same thing hosting the Oscars and didn’t get shit.
jokes.jonah_hill: Jonah Hill got famous drawing dicks in *Superbad*, then spent the rest of his career proving they were self-portraits.
jokes.rob_lowe: Rob Lowe has aged incredibly well—forty years in Hollywood, and he still looks like he’s about to get his big break.
jokes.nikki_glaser: Nikki Glaser is the queen of celebrity roasts—Hollywood’s way of saying, “You’re invited to the party, but you’re still staff.”
jokes.blake_griffin: Blake Griffin jumped over a Kia, and somehow Detroit still overpaid for the less reliable one.
jokes.caitlyn_jenner: Caitlyn Jenner won Olympic gold in the decathlon, then got 1% of the vote for governor—turns out the eleventh event was being likable.
jokes.alec_baldwin: Alec Baldwin won an Emmy for playing Trump—turns out all he needed was a wig and a slightly smaller ego.
